test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Six people, Ankita, Babita, Sheela, Damini, Pinky and Kamini are sitting in two parallel rows, three of them are facing north and the other three are facing south. Ankita is facing south. Kamini sits immediate right of Sheela. Sheela is facing Damini. Ankita does not sit at any of the extreme ends. Pinky is facing the same direction as Kamini.

 

Who is sitting to the left of Ankita?
solution:
Gine: Six people, Ankita, Babita, Sheela, Damini, Pinky and Kamini. 

Three of them are facing north and the other Three are facing south.

1) Ankita is facing south and She does not sit at any of the extreme ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f827cde66dbe9cfce8551a1faf5a54de4c52efa77332715467b704089d93d03e.png] 

2) Kamini sits immediate right of Sheela. 

3) Sheela is facing Damini.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d8160258681a6b0313b75df74fff325a9f71acc330c281c87a80024cc11ab01.png] 

4) Pinky is facing the same direction as Kamini.

And, Babita will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e97cfd62c3eb154591ff85e0cab7936bc3cc289f9260029cb6138c1648d75a90.png] 

'Babita' is sitting to the left of Ankita.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Babita"**.
